facts.business: Shraddha Prime Projects Limited is a real estate development company constructing residential projects in Mumbai suburbs.
key_risks: Revenue recognition involves significant judgement in estimating balance costs to complete and percentage of completion
Inventory valuation depends on estimates of net realizable value based on prevailing market conditions
Promoter shares pledged as security for obligations of Shraddha Housing Projects LLP (entity where promoter has significant influence)
facts.related_party_note: Promoter pledged shares as security for financing arrangements of Shraddha Housing Projects LLP, where promoter has significant influence. Company was not a borrower and had no direct obligation except the pledge over promoter's shareholding.
